title: BharatHighway Legends
prompt: Build a 2D Village & Town Highway Vehicle Racing app named BharatHighway Legends using the GAMING REACTOR (FactoryGame.startVillageRace, FactoryGame.isUnlocked, FactoryGame.unlockVehicle) with vibrant crimson-red, nitro-gold, and emerald-green 3D dark-glass styling. 1. Tab 1 (Home - #view-1): - Top 3D Driver Hero Card (.sf-hero-card) showing Player Name, Driver Rank, Total Coins, "VILLAGE HIGHWAY LIVE" badge, and a "Claim +50 Daily Fuel" button calling FactoryPro.claimDailyBonus(). - 2-Column Stat Grid (.sf-stat-grid) showing Total Races and Best Score. - Horizontal Scroll Garage (.sf-hscroll with .sf-hcard cards) of 5 Vehicles from Light to Heavy with Coin Unlock using FactoryGame.isUnlocked(id, free): 1) "Desi Scooter" (id: "scooter", 0 Coins, free=true) 2) "Bullet Superbike" (id: "bike", 100 Coins) 3) "Royal Horse" (id: "horse", 200 Coins) 4) "Gaon Express Bus" (id: "bus", 350 Coins) 5) "Heavy Bharat Truck" (id: "truck", 500 Coins) - If unlocked, tapping card launches FactoryGame.startVillageRace(vehicleName, accentColor) in full-screen village/town mode! If locked, opens Detail Page with "Unlock Now" calling FactoryGame.unlockVehicle(id, cost, vehicleName). 2. Tab 2 (Actions - #view-2): - "Create Custom Highway Cup" form (Cup Name, Vehicle Class: Scooter/Bike/Horse/Bus/Truck, Target Coins) saving via FactoryDB.saveItem("race", ...) + 2 tiles (.sf-action-tile): "Engine Sound Toggle" (FactorySound.toggle()) and "Heavy Fleet VIP Pass" (FactoryPro.showProModal("Heavy Fleet VIP Pass", "Rs. 99 / mo")). 3. Tab 3 (Records - #view-3): - Live Highway Leaderboard & Race History from FactoryDB.getItems("race") & FactoryDB.getTransactions() with live search filtering (#app-search-bar) and tap-to-open Scorecard Detail + Back button. 4. Tab 4 (Profile - #view-4) & '+' Button: - Driver Profile, "Invite Squad +25 Coins" (FactoryEngine.openReferShare()), "Driving Guide" (FactoryEngine.openTutorial()), "Download Driver License PDF" (FactoryUI.downloadPDF()), and "Reset Session" (FactoryNav.logout()). - window.onFloatingAction opens a quick "+20 Coins Sprint" modal; define clean text-only window.APP_TUTORIAL_HTML (NO tags) using template backticks.
